categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in real estate brokerage and agency services, including residential, office, factory, land, and parking space transactions and leasing. It also engages in real estate development, focusing on residential and commercial buildings, and has a tourism business segment developing resorts and hotels in Malaysia. The company operates extensive direct sales offices in Taiwan and subsidiaries in Mainland China, Japan, and Malaysia.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages digital transformation and AI technologies, including AI assistants, big data analytics, and cloud-based management dashboards to enhance brokerage services. It employs Building Information Modeling (BIM) for efficient and sustainable real estate development, focusing on ESG-compliant green building certifications and low-carbon construction methods. Digital tools also support paperless transactions and virtual property viewing experiences.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are general consumers in Taiwan seeking residential and commercial real estate brokerage services. It also serves property developers through agency sales and targets overseas Chinese and local clients in Japan for property purchase and rental management. The development segment targets homebuyers in Taiwan and Mainland China, while the tourism segment caters to international and local tourists in Malaysia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan's major metropolitan areas including Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Hsinchu, Taichung, Changhua, Tainan, and Kaohsiung. It has subsidiaries operating in Mainland China (Shanghai and Suzhou), Japan (Tokyo and Osaka), and Malaysia (Sabah region).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, providing brokerage, agency, and property development services. It also engages in upstream activities through land acquisition and real estate development projects. The tourism business is an extension into hospitality services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include digital transformation with AI integration to enhance customer service and operational efficiency. The company focuses on ESG and sustainability, aiming to be an industry benchmark in green building and low-carbon operations. It invests in AI-powered tools for property matching and client engagement, and expands its service ecosystem to include community building and comprehensive real estate solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly from brokerage commissions on property sales and leases, agency fees for new property sales, and income from real estate development projects. The tourism segment anticipates future revenue from hotel operations. The company also earns from value-added services such as property management and related consulting.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in Taiwan's real estate brokerage market with the largest number of directly operated branches, holding an estimated 6.16% to 8.31% market share in second-hand housing brokerage. It competes with other major brokerage firms and leverages brand reputation, scale, and digital innovation to maintain competitive advantage. Its development and tourism segments face competition from local and regional developers and hospitality operators.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$12.78 billion, a 10% decrease from the prior year, with net profit increasing by 2% to NT$1.807 billion. The company has stable asset growth and maintains strong equity with total assets exceeding NT$32 billion. It has a steady workforce of over 5,300 employees and continues to invest in digital transformation and sustainable development projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes trustworthy, high-quality real estate services with comprehensive transaction safeguards and innovative digital tools enhancing customer experience. It differentiates through a strong brand, extensive direct branch network, integrated service offerings across brokerage, development, and tourism, and commitment to ESG principles. Its community engagement programs and sustainable building practices further enhance its market reputation and customer loyalty.
